### Source Parity Findings

#### Finding 1: Glider deals full fall damage to riders on landing
- **Original:** [`LeavesGliderEntity.causeFallDamage(float, float)`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/entity/LeavesGliderEntity.java#L479-L481)
- **Port:** [`LeavesGliderEntity`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/fabric/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/fabric/LeavesGliderEntity.java#L18-L115) (missing override)
- **Behavior discrepancy:** In original source, `LeavesGliderEntity` overrides `causeFallDamage` returning `false` without delegating to `super.causeFallDamage`. In the port, `causeFallDamage` is not overridden. When `move(MoverType.SELF, getDeltaMovement())` executes with negative Y velocity while gliding, `fallDistance` accumulates. Upon touching the ground, vanilla `Entity.causeFallDamage` runs while passengers are still riding and inflicts accumulated fall damage to all passengers, killing or injuring them on landing.
- **Smallest correction:** Override `causeFallDamage(double, float, DamageSource)` in [`LeavesGliderEntity`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/fabric/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/fabric/LeavesGliderEntity.java) to return `false`.

---

#### Finding 2: Molotov throw consumes durability and sound on failed server validation due to client-side early success
- **Original:** [`MolotovItem.use(World, PlayerEntity, Hand)`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/item/MolotovItem.java#L78-L101)
- **Port:** [`MolotovItem.use(Level, Player, InteractionHand)`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/fabric/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/fabric/MolotovItem.java#L24-L39)
- **Behavior discrepancy:** In original source, `useFire(player, world)` runs on both logical sides before succeeding; if no fire/fuel source is present, `use` returns `ActionResult.fail(heldItem)` immediately. In the port, line 26 returns `InteractionResult.SUCCESS` immediately when `level.isClientSide()`. The client plays the arm animation and predicts item use even when the player has no fire source or fuel nearby, resulting in client/server desync and ghost throw attempts.
- **Smallest correction:** Remove `if (level.isClientSide()) return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;` in [`MolotovItem.use`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/fabric/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/fabric/MolotovItem.java#L26), check fire availability uniformly or pass/fail consistently, only returning `SUCCESS` when permitted.

#### Finding 3: Clackers ricochet bounce raycast uses inverted view vector for `AbstractArrow`
- **Original:** [`ClackersEntity.changeMovementAfterHit()`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/entity/itemprojectile/ClackersEntity.java#L108-L132)
- **Port:** [`ClackersEntity.bounce()`](file:///home/alanno/Documents/Soft/ROTP_port/fabric/src/main/java/com/github/standobyte/jojo/fabric/ClackersEntity.java#L47-L53)
- **Behavior discrepancy:** In the port, `bounce()` calculates `end = position().add(getLookAngle().scale(distanceTo(owner)))`. For `AbstractArrow`, `getLookAngle()` derives from entity pitch/yaw where arrow rotation conventions make `getLookAngle()` point backwards/inverted relative to projectile heading. The search box and endpoint for potential secondary entity hits are traced in the wrong direction rather than along the owner-to-target or trajectory vector.
- **Smallest correction:** Trace from `position()` towards `owner.getEyePosition()` using `owner.getEyePosition().subtract(position()).normalize()` instead of `getLookAngle()`.
